learn.intro: The internet is a huge library with millions of books, cartoons and games. Today we get a ticket!

slides.text: To get into the internet library you need a program — a **browser**. It is like a library ticket.

options: A program — a ticket to the internet

slides.text: Every website has an **address**, like a house. Type it in the address bar at the top, press **Enter** — and you are visiting the site.
The **back arrow** returns to the previous page. The **round arrow** refreshes. The cursor turned into a **hand** — it is a link you can click.

check.prompt: If the cursor turns into a hand, you can click it.

slides.text: You can open several sites at once — each on its own **tab**, like bookmarks in a book. The **plus** opens a new tab, the **cross** on a tab closes it.

check.prompt: How do you open a new tab?
check.explain: The plus opens a new tab.
